body:
**Goal.** Propose an account from the user's own history only when both gates pass.

## Scope
- Index per `(source_account, sign)`; TF-IDF (term frequency–inverse document frequency) `char_wb` vectors, cosine nearest neighbours.
- Distance gate and vote-margin gate; failing either falls through, it never lowers a threshold.
- Provenance: only `observed`/`corrected` rows enter the index; synthetic rows cannot.
- Single destination account only; never a split.

## Done when (red→green)
The planted novel merchant abstains on the distance gate; a split vote abstains on the margin gate; a synthetic-tagged row is refused by the index.

Synthetic data only: no real statement, memo, IBAN, document or correspondent name in any fixture.

**Depends on:** #22, #23

**Design:** [proposal 0001](https://github.com/Ralphovi/autobook/blob/main/docs/design/proposals/draft/0001-gnucash-auto-booking-pipeline.md) (*kNN*), [architecture ch.5](https://github.com/Ralphovi/autobook/blob/main/docs/design/architecture/05-building-block-view.md), [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Ralphovi/autobook/blob/main/AGENTS.md) (*Classification rules*)
